Title: BGP Route Hijack Early Warning System

Title: Automated API Token Leakage Revocation Bot
Description: Design a continuous scanner that detects accidentally committed secrets in public code repositories and initiates instant invalidation hooks with major cloud and SaaS providers.

Title: Post-Mortem Memory Dump Forensic Analyzer
Description: Create a browser-based visualization tool that parses raw RAM dumps from compromised Linux servers to trace kernel rootkits and inject processes.
